target.statement: End-to-end accuracy of 97.25% across all classes (including normal) on the second (single-point) dataset, exceeding the TLFed benchmark of 94.84%
target.dataset: Electrical Fault Detection and Classification (Kaggle, Sathyaprakash 2021), 12,001 samples, L=1, 18 features

compute.basis: Only the second dataset is public (Kaggle); the pipeline is sklearn Isolation Forest + Random Forest on 12k samples x 18 features, so all fitting/scoring is seconds-to-minutes on CPU, dominated by download/install and re-implementing the feature operator and two-stage logic from the text.

blockers: No code released; pipeline (feature operator, Branch B allocation rule, OR-fusion, threshold selection) must be re-implemented from prose
Exact 97.25% depends on unspecified split seed, validation split, and Branch B threshold, so exact reproduction is unlikely
Primary TLFaultDataset (578,923 samples) is not clearly public, so the headline cross-dataset claim cannot be fully checked
title: A Hybrid Two-Stage Machine Learning Pipeline for Fault Detection and Classification in Power Transmission Systems
